2026-11-15-nusuk-chat-figma-round.json.name: NusukChat 2.7.0: Figma round and English mode

changed.change: Ghost button label: عرض كافة التذاكر → عرض كافة الرحلات المتاحة
Option cards lead with DL icon alert-circle (was support)
Header Nusuk Bot, _Eyes and City Logo are library instances again; DL known issue F32 (unpublished components) can close
New prop buttons: true renders each suggestion as DL Button MD (kind primary by default, prop kind), leading arrow-left-02 in Arabic and arrow-right-02 in English. Default rendering unchanged.

NusukChat.setLang('en' | 'ar') and NusukChat.lang(): built-in labels in English (Edit answer, copy and vote labels, typing indicator, Question type and CTA defaults, Tab Bar placeholder, limit text and button labels, Try again). Arabic stays the default.

tokens.checked: ⚙️ Foundation Colors (3 light modes), Layout (Mobile), 🕹️ Buttons Setup: 0 differences with tokens.css 3.8
